title: datasources: `POST /datasources/NAME/external/validate` answers an unknown name `200` with an empty report, where every other by-name datasource door answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Found by the #27618 card thread (os-dev-report on #27618, `out_of_scope_findings`, read from the code, not measured). Same family as #27510 / #27618: by-name doors disagree on an unknown name.

## What is wrong

PR #27693 (#27618) makes the federation guard answer a name that no saved datasource has `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` on the Sync doors and their `/external/` twins (`tables`, `tables/:remote/draft`, `tables/:remote/import`, `refresh-catalog`), as `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name` does. `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/external/validate` (`packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts`, `validateDatasource(:name)`) does not run that guard: for a name that resolves no saved datasource it answers `200` with an empty report (`ok: true`, no results). A caller cannot tell "this datasource has nothing to validate" from "this datasource does not exist".

Re-check after #27693 merges: `POST /api/v1/datasources/nope/external/validate` as an admin, and compare with `GET /api/v1/datasources/nope`.

## Expected

The validate door answers an unknown name `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` through the package's one `datasourceNotFoundError`, before any validation, like its by-name siblings. A datasource that exists and has nothing federated keeps its `200` empty report. A narrowing (`200` → `404`): `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, contract review before approval.

Filed without `domain:*`; grading is triage's.
